subject: Australian magpie
hook: AUSTRALIAN MAGPIE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Australian magpies are capable of holding long-term grudges against specific humans, but there is disagreement regarding their facial recognition capacity, with estimates ranging from 30 to over 100 individual faces.
angle_support: Research has shown that magpies can recognise at least 100 different people, and may be less likely to swoop individuals they have befriended.
Magpies can remember up to about 30 faces, and Professor Jones said the long local grudge was not unusual.
title: The Bird That Remembers Your Face for Years
description: Australian magpies are famous for their aggressive swooping behavior, but they are far more intelligent than people realize. They can remember individual human faces for over a decade, turning minor conflicts into long-term personal feuds.
narration: AUSTRALIAN MAGPIE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You assume these birds are just randomly aggressive during nesting season. It was closer to a targeted, years-long personal vendetta against specific people they recognize by sight. Research indicates these birds possess remarkable facial recognition capabilities. While some experts estimate they remember thirty unique human faces, other studies suggest they can identify at least one hundred individuals, allowing them to hold grudges for over fifteen years. Never underestimate the memory of a bird with a long grudge.
